reproduction.expected: The repository-onboarding transport and evaluator can bind the current B28 workspace to the selected protected GitHub repository before WP-08 is authorized.
reproduction.actual: The evaluator requires PHASE_CANDIDATE_MANIFEST.json even though B28 deleted it, the transport requests that deleted path remotely, and a normal GitHub checkout is rejected because .git is treated as a runtime directory.

violated_invariants: Repository onboarding must be executable against the current authoritative workspace shape.
A GitHub checkout must not be rejected merely because its VCS metadata directory exists.
The remote marker must use a current versioned identity document and remain exact and fail closed.
